observed_source_defects: donor route decision digest binds derived routing result and generation but not immutable causal event identity
distinct causal events choosing the same lanes/projection can alias to the same route decision digest
donor internal-provider authority is a finite denylist, so unknown provider labels can pass the negative test
material unknown event fields can be omitted from routing identity unless the schema rejects them
hypothesis: One route identity chain H(normalized causal event) -> positive local engine admission -> H(event_digest + engine_identity + routing_result) prevents event/engine aliasing without creating another authority path.
counterhypotheses: generation plus routing result is sufficient because downstream semantics do not require exact causal-event replay identity
a finite external-provider denylist is sufficient because all relevant providers are already enumerated
hashing the raw event would be safer than a typed normalized event contract
discriminators: two materially distinct event ids with identical routing outputs must produce distinct event and decision digests
same exact event replay with same admitted engine must reproduce identical digests
model activation with missing or non-local engine class must fail closed
unknown event fields must fail rather than silently disappear from identity

unusual_experiment.name: CAUSAL_EVENT_ALIAS_COLLISION_PAIR
unusual_experiment.definition: Two causal events differ only in event_id while crossing identical thresholds and selecting the same lanes/projection; the repaired route must preserve identical routing behavior but produce distinct event_sha256 and decision_sha256.

next_exact_gate: run the focused EntityOS/HCU router regressions on an actually-started authorized isolated executor bound to exact branch bytes
bind the same event_sha256 and engine identity into the downstream HCU inference receipt
only then consider fusion into current main; no HCU runtime or whole EntityOS credit before exact execution
